sources.label: Wikipedia, "Tau Pegasi"
sources.quote: Tau Pegasi, formally named Salm, is a magnitude 4.6 star 162 light-years away in the constellation of Pegasus.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 3.0 solar radii and 2.05 solar masses (FLAME) and 7,603 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Tau Pegasi"
sources.quote: With about twice the mass of the Sun and thirty times as luminous, it is a δ Scuti variable star with its brightness changing by a few hundredths of a magnitude over about an hour.
